## Lecture outline (draft)

- **Problem:** Wave packets and tunnelling; $2\nu$ oscillations (exact) and $3\nu$ oscillations in matter of varying density.
- **Tools:** Crank–Nicolson and unitarity, split-step with the FFT, the matrix exponential (`expm`).
- **Lead author:** Dmitry V. Naumov.
